description: This file defines the class OperatorPrecedenceChange, which represents a change in operator precedence within the Twig templating engine. It contains properties for package name, version, and new precedence level, along with corresponding getter methods.

classes.name: OperatorPrecedenceChange
classes.description: Represents a precedence change for an operator in Twig. Stores package info, version, and new precedence level, and provides getters for this data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the package, version, and new precedence properties.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Returns the package name related to the precedence change.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version associated with the precedence change.

methods.name: getNewPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the new precedence level for the operator.
